title: Attractive and functional
text: Attractive and functional. Towel bar rocks on the counter. Also, the paint was chipped off one of the top end balls. I would have given this 5 stars, but I subtracted one star for each flaw.

product_metadata.title: mDesign Steel Countertop Hand Towel Holder - 2-Tier Freestanding Small Towel Stand for Bathroom Counter and Vanity - Washcloth, Tea Towel, and Hand Towel Holder Stand - Hyde Collection - Matte Satin
features: CONVENIENT STORAGE: This countertop towel stand features 2 bars for hanging small decorative fingertip towels of different thicknesses; The 2-tier design lets you hang two matching or coordinating towels or washcloths; Decorative feet keep rack slightly elevated from countertop surfaces to stay dry and free of debris; The stylish curves of the free-standing rack add a decorative touch to any bathroom or home; Ideal for guest bathrooms to keep towels at the ready

COMPACT DESIGN: Make the most of tight spaces in your bathroom by taking advantage of unused corners or awkward areas on the vanity or countertop with this slim towel stand rack; No drilling or mounting into walls is necessary; Simply place the rack where it's most convenient for your space; Arrives assembled and ready to use - just place it on your tabletop, counter, or vanity surface

STYLISH ACCESSORY: Provides smart, compact storage while adding a touch of style to any bathroom environment; Use one in every bathroom throughout your home to make towels conveniently accessible for you or your visiting guests; Please note that this item is intended for mini fingertip towels that usually measure 18 inches long when flat - folded they will hang down approximately 9 inches, fitting perfectly on this small towel stand
QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of strong steel metal with a durable finish; Designed for use in moisture-rich bathroom environments; EASY CARE: Clean with mild soap and water
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Measures 6" x 8.75" x 13.6" high
